::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A modest but concrete marker of Teradyne (automated test equipment) deepening its India commitment beyond sales — a dedicated local hub for customer engagement, applications support, and training, at Bagmane Cosmos Tech Park.
:::

## What does this facility supply?

Applications support, training, and strategic-partnership engagement for semiconductor test equipment customers in India.
